forward (saves x, q, k, v, g, b, o, lse, w_4, w_o, prm, ds)
q, k, v, g = (x_n @ W.T for W in w_4)
F3 · gate + out proj + dropout + residual
mask, ds, W_*, w_4, w_o, prm
do, dg = du * s_g, du * o * s_g * (1 - s_g)
dp = do @ v.T; ds_ = p * (dp - Δ)
dv = p.T @ do; dk = ds_.T @ q / sqrt(32)
dx_n = cat(dq, dk, dv, dg) @ w_4 + db @ W_b
M[t] = xhat.T @ d[t] (t = q, k, v, g)
dW[t] = γ * M[t] + outer(β, d[t].sum(0)); dγ, dβ, dW_b
